When you hail Guntrik, he will say 'Mmmph!! Who you? Oh.  you <player name>.  You supposed to be promising Craknek.  Me need you.  There bad things in swamp.  You want [help Crakneks] or you [want Guntrik bash your face]!!?'

Yes, he will actually attack you if you tell him you want him to bash your face.
